newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Angry Moldovan farmers hang cucumber thief.
newsitem.headline: Angry Moldovan farmers hang cucumber thief.

text.p: An unemployed man has been found hanging from a tree with a cucumber stuck in his mouth in rural Moldova, apparently killed by vegetable growers angry at widespread theft of their produce, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday.
Tass said the body hung for four hours on a tree by a country road, scaring passing motorists near the town of Dubasari in Moldova's separatist Dnestr region.
"Despairing of help from police, local residents guard their gardens in turns and punish thieves themselves," Tass quoted a secretary for the local authorities as saying.

Lynchings of thieves by farmers and weekending city dwellers are not uncommon in Moldova, where law enforcement bodies offer little protection against the theft of vegetables during harvest each year.

Earlier this summer, an angry mob caught several thieves near the capital Chisinau, beat them up, removed their clothes, smeared them with faeces and led them through the neighbourhood insulting them.
